verdict.rationale: A state agency with an online employer filing portal could plausibly publish versioned APIs, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only web portal (EAMS/eServices), paper, email and fax workflows. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all returned 404, and the transactional host sits behind a login wall. Nothing documents a versioned API or a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
